desc:
Go to Space on a nostalgic adventure with your friends and visit the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury and Titan!
Visit the Galilean Moons of Ganymede, Europa, Io, and Callisto and look at Jupiter from up close!
Deliver packages to planets and get Money that you can spend on suits to stand out from others!
Build massive bases on other celestial bodies to do research and earn even more Money! (temporarily disabled)

Languages: English, Polish
Other languages are also supported, but the translations may be incorrect
